verdict.rationale: The only guarantee in the evidence is attached to AutoFile's filing and remittance service and its deadlines. Nothing documents an accuracy guarantee for calculations TaxJar produces, or an audit-support commitment if a calculation proves wrong. A filing-deadline guarantee is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the vendor stands behind its numbers — a documented accuracy guarantee or audit support commitment if a calculation it produced turns out wrong

citations.quote: AutoFile handles state tax returns and remittances for you, ensuring deadlines are never missed – all backed by our guarantee.
